title: BlueMind mock test import file
description: A complete mock test (both sections, both modules) for `npm run db:import-mock -- <folder>`. The folder holds this mock.json plus a figures/ directory with the images it references. Text fields use the same markup the admin editor uses: $...$ inline LaTeX, $$...$$ block LaTeX, *italic*, __underline__, and a run of 6 underscores (______) for a fill-in-the-blank.

subtitle.description: Form / version label shown under the title, e.g. "International Form A".

month.description: Real SAT administration month (the public library hides any other month).

text.description: May be empty for an image-only choice.

image.description: File name inside figures/ shown for this choice.

number.description: 1-based position within the module; must be sequential.

passageText.description: Reading & Writing only: the left-pane passage/stimulus. Use "Text 1" / "Text 2" headings (no colon) for paired texts and bullet lines for student notes.

questionText.description: R&W: the question stem shown on the right. Math: the whole question.

image.description: File name inside figures/ for a chart, table or diagram shown with the question.

choices.description: Exactly A–D for multiple choice; empty array for SPR.

correctAnswer.description: Choice id (A–D) or, for SPR, the numeric answer; several accepted answers may be comma-separated ("2,-2").

rationale.description: One- or two-sentence reason the correct answer is right.

explanation.description: Full walkthrough, including why the other choices are wrong.

estimatedTime.description: Seconds; defaults to 71 for R&W and 95 for Math.
